title: Effects of plant polyphenols on water-holding capacity and quality of frozen bighead carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis) fillets: insights from molecular docking.
authors: Liu, Chenxi; Wang, Yiming; Yu, Qinye; Mubango, Elliot; Luo, Yongkang; Tan, Yuqing; Hong, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物多酚对冷冻鳙鱼片保水性和品质的影响，虽含分子对接分析，但核心是食品冷冻保存实验，蛋白质仅作为食品基质，非蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: This study evaluated dihydromyricetin (DMY), tannic acid (Tan), and resveratrol (Res) as natural cryoprotectants for bighead carp (Hypophthalmichthys nobilis) fillets during frozen storage (-20  degrees C, 8 weeks). Fillets treated with 0.1% (w/w) polyphenols were compared with a water control and a commercial sucrose-sorbitol cryoprotectant. Changes in water migration, water-holding capacity, protein and lipid oxidation, protein conformation, odor profiles, and sensory quality were systematically investigated, together with molecular docking analysis. Frozen storage induced progressive conversion of immobilized water to free water, accompanied by increased moisture loss and oxidative deterioration, whereas polyphenol treatments significantly mitigated these effects. Res restricted free-water formation and preserved water-holding capacity the most effectively, while Tan exhibited the strongest inhibition of lipid oxidation. Both Res and Tan better maintained myofibrillar protein secondary and tertiary structures and sensory quality during prolonged storage, whereas DMY mainly exerted protective effects at the early storage stage. Molecular docking analysis demonstrated favorable binding of all three polyphenols to beta-actin, with docking scores of -8.0 kcal/mol for Tan, -6.5 kcal/mol for DMY, and - 5.5 kcal/mol for Res, indicating distinct protein interaction modes. Overall, 0.1% resveratrol and tannic acid best preserved water-holding capacity and inhibited oxidation in frozen bighead carp fillets, with molecular docking revealing stable polyphenol-beta-actin interactions. These polyphenols show promise as targeted cryoprotectants for frozen fish.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了二氢杨梅素（dihydromyricetin, DMY）、单宁酸（tannic acid, Tan）和白藜芦醇（resveratrol, Res）作为天然冷冻保护剂，在冷冻贮藏（-20°C，8周）期间对鳙鱼（Hypophthalmichthys nobilis）鱼片的作用。将经0.1%（w/w）多酚处理的鱼片与清水对照组及商业蔗糖-山梨醇冷冻保护剂组进行比较。系统研究了水分迁移、持水性、蛋白质和脂质氧化、蛋白质构象、气味特征及感官品质的变化，并结合分子对接分析。冷冻贮藏诱导固定水逐渐转化为自由水，伴随水分损失增加和氧化劣变加剧，而多酚处理显著缓解了这些影响。Res最有效地限制了自由水的形成并保持了持水性，而Tan对脂质氧化的抑制最强。在长期贮藏期间，Res和Tan均更好地维持了肌原纤维蛋白的二级和三级结构及感官品质，而DMY主要在贮藏早期发挥保护作用。分子对接分析显示，三种多酚均能与β-肌动蛋白良好结合，对接分数分别为Tan -8.0 kcal/mol、DMY -6.5 kcal/mol和Res -5.5 kcal/mol，表明存在不同的蛋白质相互作用模式。总体而言，0.1%白藜芦醇和单宁酸最能保持冷冻鳙鱼鱼片的持水性并抑制氧化，分子对接揭示了稳定的多酚-β-肌动蛋白相互作用。这些多酚有望作为冷冻鱼类的靶向冷冻保护剂。
